verdict.rationale: 01 is an open-source platform that runs a server (Light and Livekit) talking to separate clients, so a published machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask for. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any standard path (all 404), and no evidence item mentions one. The llms.txt file that does exist is a docs index, not an API spec, so it earns no credit here.
